crew.name: A-Share Market Research Crew
crew.purpose: Verify current A-share heat signals and produce a bounded stock information report with non-personalized trading suggestions.

roles.name: Market Heat Analyst
roles.accountability: Identify currently active A-share stocks using recent market heat, trading activity, sector attention, and public market signals.
roles.boundary: Owns shortlist construction and heat evidence; does not issue final trading suggestions.
acceptance_checks: Every selected stock has a current public heat or trading activity basis.
Stocks with weak evidence are removed or marked low confidence.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize A-share market activity, current catalysts, and recent turnover or attention signals.

roles.name: Company Fundamental Analyst
roles.accountability: Summarize each company's business, financial context, valuation signal, and public disclosure constraints.
roles.boundary: Owns company-level public information; does not rely on non-public information or personalized suitability.
acceptance_checks: Company identity and ticker are verified.
Business and financial summaries are grounded in public evidence.
Unverified or stale information is marked clearly.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Focus on public company information relevant to short-to-medium-term market interest.

roles.name: Catalyst And Risk Analyst
roles.accountability: Identify recent catalysts, uncertainty, regulatory risk, valuation risk, liquidity risk, and crowding risk.
roles.boundary: Owns risk and catalyst framing; does not suppress negative conclusions.
acceptance_checks: Recent catalysts are dated or source-bounded.
Risks are specific rather than generic.
Weak evidence reduces confidence or downgrades the suggestion.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Evaluate whether market heat is supported by durable catalysts or only short-term speculation.

roles.name: Trading Suggestion Reviewer
roles.accountability: Translate evidence into bounded, non-personalized trading suggestion categories under the confirmed time horizon and risk frame.
roles.boundary: Owns classification language; must not provide personalized investment advice, guaranteed returns, or automated trading instructions.
acceptance_checks: Each suggestion category is bounded by the confirmed horizon and risk frame.
No suggestion relies on undisclosed user portfolio facts.
High-uncertainty stocks are downgraded to watch or avoid.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Use watch, buy_on_pullback, hold, take_profit_or_reduce, or avoid categories.

roles.name: Report Synthesizer
roles.accountability: Produce the final report with stock table, per-stock analysis, risk notes, suggestions, and follow-up indicators.
roles.boundary: Owns final structure and clarity; must preserve evidence limits and reviewer risk classifications.
acceptance_checks: Report includes shortlist, evidence, risks, suggestion, and tracking indicators.
Facts, assumptions, inferences, and unknowns are separated when material.
The report does not overstate certainty.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Deliver a concise but decision-useful A-share hot-stock information report.
